description: Done-gates for UI consolidation: every value comes from generated tokens, every shared responsibility is one registry component on every surface, and every screen is a composition of those components. Consolidation is done, and the redesign starts, when every gate is at target. Measured by node tool/design/consolidation_gates.mjs. 'enforcement' names what blocks regressions today.

gates.title: Raw design values in Flutter code
gates.enforcement: Workspace analysis runs with --fatal-infos, so any catch_ui_lints finding fails CI.

gates.title: Website stylesheets exempt from the raw-colour rules
Recorded raw CSS lengths, values and media queries
gates.owner: UI blueprint Phase 7g, lowered by 7e and website Phase 4 migrations
gates.enforcement: stylelint suppressions are shrink-only with a freshness check (packages/web-config/lint/check-stylelint-suppressions.mjs).

gates.title: T1 registry contracts without a styled @catch/web-ui component
gates.enforcement: None yet: no check requires a T1 contract to have a styled React implementation.

gates.title: Priority-1 T2 entities the website needs, without a styled component
Registry contracts still mapped to an unstyled *Control that each app skins
gates.owner: UI blueprint Phase 7e (D10: *Control exports become package internals)

gates.title: T1 contracts whose Widgetbook states their styled Storybook story does not cover
gates.enforcement: None yet. This is the state-coverage half of Phase 7f: a contract counts once it has a styled @catch/web-ui component whose ready Storybook story, keyed through its registry record, declares every state of its Widgetbook contract preview. Screenshot baselines for both frameworks join the rule when 7f lands them.

gates.title: Per-app React adapters waiting for a shared component
gates.enforcement: web:shared-ui-adoption classifies every export but does not ratchet the count.

gates.title: Unused React exports and files

baseline.source: knip (tool/audit/unused_code_baseline.json); the React inventory counted 109 before #783 fixed its Next route roots

gates.owner: Website Phase 4 and Admin (Phase 7 'screens become assemblies')
gates.enforcement: audit:unused-code (knip) keeps tool/audit/unused_code_baseline.json shrink-only; this gate counts its unused exports and files per web workspace, and falls back to the React inventory only if that file is missing.

gates.title: Shared React exports that only one feature renders
gates.owner: Website Phase 4 and Admin. Under blueprint D18 ("the library draws; features arrange and bind") each one becomes a registered @catch/web-ui component; none moves into a feature.
gates.enforcement: None yet, and the measure is provisional. The React inventory counts any shared export with one owner as t4-move, @catch/web-ui included, and the registry rejects a React record on T3/T4 entries, so a component registered under D18 would still be counted. The D18 prerequisite (Linear CAT-225, PR #796) lets a T4 entry carry its one framework record and owning surface, with the component in packages/web-ui/src/components/, and maps those rows to concept; only then does this gate fall for the right reason. Until then, new React one-offs stay in their app shared/ui.

gates.title: Bare HTML elements outside @catch/web-ui
gates.owner: UI blueprint Phase 7g (ESLint no-bare-elements) with website Phase 4 and Admin migrations
gates.enforcement: None yet: the 7g ESLint preset adds react/forbid-elements with bulk suppressions in website/ and admin/eslint-suppressions.json. Once a surface has that file, this gate counts the rule's suppressions instead of the source scan.

gates.title: Lines of page-scoped CSS outside base.css and catch-language.css
gates.enforcement: None: suppressions cover raw values inside these stylesheets, not their size.

gates.title: Flutter Text widgets styled in place instead of by a CatchText role
gates.enforcement: None yet: a source scan until CAT-211 adds its lint.

gates.title: Hand-built decoration, clipping and tap targets in Flutter feature code
gates.enforcement: Partial: catch_ui_lints rejects raw Material controls; decoration and gesture wrappers are unchecked.

gates.title: Near-duplicate Flutter widget clusters awaiting a merge or keep decision
gates.enforcement: None: the similarity build reports clusters but nothing ratchets them.

gates.title: Feature widgets the library should absorb
